verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a dedicated Retention report for assessing user engagement over a specified period of time, and retention can also be queried via its MCP server. Cohorts exist as property-defined user groups and can be returned via the Query API, but nothing explicitly shows retention being broken down or segmented by behavioral cohorts. missing for 10: explicit evidence of slicing retention by cohorts, evidence that cohorts can be defined by behavior (events performed), independent or hands-on corroboration of the retention report.
